0022600023.text: The Warriors, now 2-3 and 10th in the West, host the 4-1 Lakers, who lead the Pacific and sit third in the West, in their sixth game of the season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Gui Santos (day-to-day, game-time decision, knee tendinitis), while Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (out, foot). The Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 127-105 in Los Angeles on October 21, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
